description: Qwen3-4B, thinking on, 16,384-token budget per game (the 8k run ran out after ~3 guesses at ~2,400 tokens of thinking per guess). Baseline on the 20 held-out words at 16k, then low-rank LoRA GRPO for 25 steps (50 of the 100 training words, 16 games per step) with an evaluation on the same 20 words at step 25; checkpoints every 10 steps. Plain sampling (temperature 1.0), per-token vLLM correction. Memory (A100 40 GB): vLLM 65% for the baseline (~16 GB KV, ~110k tokens, ~6 full-length 17k-token games at once) and 50% for training (~10 GB KV, ~70k tokens, ~4 full-length games at once).
